```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
```

I now visualise the data from the csv file I downloaded from the website ukhsa-dashboard.data.gov.uk/.
```{r}
rhinovirus <- read_csv("data/ukhsa-chart-download-rhinovirus.csv")

gt(head(rhinovirus))
```
```{r}
weather <- read_csv("data/weather_data.csv")
ggplot(weather, aes(
  x = observation_time,
  y = temperature_c
)) + 
  geom_line(colour = "gold") +
  xlab("Date") +
  ylab("Temp(C)") +
  ggtitle("Temperature by Date")
```
